The '''Nursery''' was the central chamber of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Sh'rip Sh'pa|seedship]] where [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] was kept during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. In it, developing [[dhuryam]]s trained by controlling [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] gangs.
